name: The Prince
description: Following the death of the king, the youngest and least loved royal son -- known simply as “Prince” -- assumes the throne in the Kingdom of Bongomia.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Bongomia is threatened by the Hungarian Empire. King Thun chooses to fight for honor.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: At the temple funeral, the Prince reveals the truth behind the king's death, prompting Kalesh to act.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The Prince visits Kalesh to show him a play, and envoy Sangu offers the Prince a spot in the gladiator games.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Kalesh is sentenced to death in exile but is saved by Hungarian assassins. The public’s love for the Prince grows, as Thenio’s fears increase.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The Prince is now the KING!

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: While planning strategy before the Hungarian war, Hasharia’s offer of help is rejected. The Prince and his team get lost in France.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The Hungarian King agrees to the Prince’s demand and releases the Saxe-Meiningen heir. The Prince, heir, and Hasharia escape together.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The Prince is now the VIZIER :/

videos.title: Küçük Oyunlar Büyük Düsler
videos.overview: While the effects of the Hungarian War continue in the Kingdom of Bongomia, on the other hand, the wedding preparations for Hasharia begin. The wizard that the prince "found on the ground" causes a stir.

videos.title: Kaderine Terk Edilmis Krallik
videos.overview: The Prince, who sets out in response to a call from the Kingdom of Sweden, finds himself in trouble.

videos.title: Olu Yelkenler Ugruna
videos.overview: During their fun night in Lomberto, Van Dijk makes an interesting proposal to the Prince.

videos.title: Valhalla
videos.overview: The Prince battles rivals from all over the world who come to the North Kingdom for Princess Caren. Hasharia, who goes to Saxony with Philippe, finds herself in a family she is not accustomed to.

videos.title: Kuzey Unutmaz
videos.overview: The family reunites in Bongomia again. An unexpected event occurs at Hasharia's wedding.

videos.title: Intikam ve Masumiyet
videos.overview: The Prince and Kalesh go to the Kingdom of France to seek help. Larg and Orion return to Bongomia with a gift.

videos.title: Kadinlarin Çagi Basliyor
videos.overview: We are from Bongomia. In our family, we don't betray each other.

videos.title: Bes Isaret
videos.overview: Now under Hungarian Rule, Bogomia's royal family struggles to adapt to their harrowing circumstances.

videos.title: Veliaht ve Istikrar
videos.overview: After the suspicious Hungarian retreat, there is a debate in Bongomia about who will take responsibility for the crown prince.

videos.title: Istemem Eksik Olsun
videos.overview: The Prince and his family set off for Venice. The Prince's traumas come to the surface as he has a claim from this city.

videos.title: Yarim Kalan Intikam
videos.overview: While Hasharia, who has discovered palace intrigues, searches for the truth, Thenio meets a mysterious Venetian woman.

videos.title: Sezar'in Ölümü
videos.overview: A mysterious plan emerges regarding the role the Prince will undertake in a theater play in Venice.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: While the prince and his aides set sail for other waters full of adventure, an unexpected almighty hand reaches out for help.

videos.title: Itilaf ve Ittifak
videos.overview: The Prince is trying to get used to his new situation and prove himself. In Venice, while the throne and power struggles continue, new developments that will affect everyone's fate occur.

videos.title: Mahser Günü
videos.overview: Everyone makes their final preparations before the great conflict. As the Prince and Hasharia are torn between family ties and loyalty, Thenio is on the verge of a difficult decision.
